text:
maya: 🚨 tiny victory post! we just crossed 6,000,000 monthly inference requests 🎉🎉🎉
liam: WHAT. heck yes!! :tada: :rocket:
sophia: omg congrats team!! how long did that take from last milestone?
maya: ~3 months since the last spike — most of it thanks to the new batching + cache suggestions from optimize. big shoutout to eng-runtime and devex 🙌
kevin: pushing a real confetti gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/confetti-happy-3o6ZsY8v1a2b5YfE2Q
anna: tiny poll — cake 🍰 or bubble tea 🧋 to celebrate in-office tomorrow? +1 cake, +2 bubble tea
liam: bubble tea for me. I will not say no to taro.
sophia: cake pls, I brought candles last time and they were wasted 
kevin: can we get both and call it a boba-cake hybrid? 😂
maya: celebrate-bot created a poll: "Cake vs Bubble Tea" — cake: 3 votes, bubble tea: 2 votes. Poll closes in 2h.
anna: also — team lunch on Friday? I can order from the place next to 4th st.
liam: yes to lunch. and can we hang a tiny banner near the kitchen?
sophia: i'll bring balloons and a speaker with a playlist. suggestions: celebratory bops only.
kevin: pride-of-the-ops shoutout: latency P95 held steady during the surge. 🎖️
maya: love that. ops team earned a real-life cookie.
anna: cookie + boba = peak engineering morale
liam: quick mini-announcement draft for #announcements: "We hit 6M monthly inference requests — thank you to everyone who shipped improvements, supported incidents, and kept the models humming."
sophia: sgtm. add a line thanking customers and linking the dashboard snapshot.
maya: drafting now, will ping for reviews in ~10m.
kevin: tiny brag: my plant is also thriving. coincidence? probably not.
celebrate-bot: reaction :tada: added by maya
liam: GIF battle time — dropping my contribution: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-success-1
sophia: ok that's peak. meeting-free Friday afternoon for those who want to hang?
maya: approved. we'll do snacks at 3pm. thanks everyone — couldn’t have done it without you ❤️
anna: <3
kevin: :chef: ordering bubble tea + cookies. see you Friday!
liam: bravo team. next stop: 10M :)
